criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to problems with physical or virtual cards, including activation, expiration, and malfunction.

categories.name: Fraud and Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized use of cards or accounts, including suspected fraud and requests to freeze accounts.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions and issues related to verifying identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Transfers and Payments
categories.definition: Inquiries about money transfers, including pending transfers, declined transactions, and transfer fees.

categories.name: Refunds and Chargebacks
categories.definition: Requests and issues related to obtaining refunds or disputing charges.

categories.name: Top-Up and Account Funding
categories.definition: Questions about adding funds to accounts, including methods, limits, and fees.

categories.name: ATM and Cash Withdrawals
categories.definition: Issues and questions related to using ATMs, including fees, incorrect amounts, and card retention.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with various banking services, including card payments and withdrawals.

categories.name: Exchange Rates and Currency
categories.definition: Questions about currency exchange rates and the ability to exchange currencies.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests and issues related to managing account details, including name changes and account deletion.

categories.name: PIN and Security
categories.definition: Concerns and questions about PIN codes, including resetting and blocking.

categories.name: Service Availability and Locations
categories.definition: Inquiries about the availability of services in different locations and supported countries.
